#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100000000; i += 25) {
        std::string test = std::to_string(i);
        if (test.length() != s.length()) continue;
        int xChar = -1;
        bool matches = true;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
            char sChar = s[j];
            char tChar = test[j];
            if (sChar == 'X') {
                if (xChar == -1) {
                    xChar = tChar;
                }
                if (tChar != xChar) {
                    matches = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (sChar != '_') {
                if (tChar != sChar) {
                    matches = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (matches) count++;
    }
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
